name: 2-kb-kettlebell-sumo-deadlift-high-pull
instructions:
1. Position the kettlebells between your legs and assume a wider than shoulder width stance (determined by your hip structure and limb length).
2. Push your hips back and hinge forward until your torso is nearly parallel with the floor.
3. Reach down and grasp the handles of the bells with both hands.
4. Inhale, drop your hips, and keep the chest up tall.
5. Drive through the whole foot and focus on pushing the floor away.
6. As the kettlebells nears your hips and your legs lock out, shrug the shoulders and then pull aggressively with the arms.
7. The kettlebells should rise to sternum level at the completion of the movement.
8. As the kettlebells return to the hip position, reverse the movement by pushing the hips back and hinging forward.
9. Return the kettlebells to the floor, reset, and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
